name: vpnconfig
description: VPN Config Lambda — manage per-tenant Site-to-Site VPN connections

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild index.mjs dedicated-ip.mjs dedicated-ip-state.mjs dedicated-ip-resources.mjs --entry-names=./[name] --bundle --minify --sourcemap --platform=node --target=node20.16 --outdir=dist --external:@aws-sdk/* --external:admin-auth
